items_all.title: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
items_all.summary: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.
items_all.title_original: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
items_all.title_en: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
items_all.title_zh: 亚马逊告诉工程师停止“tokenmaxshing”以看起来更有效率
items_all.title_bilingual: 亚马逊告诉工程师停止“tokenmaxshing”以看起来更有效率 / Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
items_all.summary_zh: 亚马逊发布了新的工程指南，警告开发人员和管理人员不要“tokenmaxshing”，认为人工智能使用指标“存在严重缺陷”，除非与长期结果挂钩。此前，优步和埃森哲也对支出存在类似担忧。

items_all_raw.summary: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.

items_all_raw.title_en: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive

items_all_raw.summary_zh: 亚马逊发布了新的工程指南，警告开发人员和管理人员不要“tokenmaxshing”，认为人工智能使用指标“存在严重缺陷”，除非与长期结果挂钩。此前，优步和埃森哲也对支出存在类似担忧。
